# NextGen SEO Agency

> Professional SEO services, expert link building, and AI-powered SEO strategies by Tayyab Mehmood. Trusted by 200+ businesses worldwide for 300%+ organic traffic growth.

## About

NextGen SEO Agency is a professional search engine optimization agency founded by Tayyab Mehmood, an SEO expert with 10+ years of experience. We specialize in on-page SEO, off-page link building, technical SEO, local SEO, and AI-powered SEO strategies for small businesses, startups, and enterprises.

## Services

- [On-Page SEO Optimization](https://nextgenseo.pro/service_onpage): Keyword strategy, meta tag optimization, heading structure, internal linking, and content optimization for Google rankings.
- [Off-Page SEO & Link Building](https://nextgenseo.pro/service_offpage): Professional white-hat link building, digital PR, backlink gap analysis, and competitor link strategy.
- [Technical SEO](https://nextgenseo.pro/service_technical): Core Web Vitals optimization, schema markup, crawl budget management, HTTPS, and mobile SEO.
- [AI-Powered SEO](https://nextgenseo.pro/service_ai): Predictive analytics, semantic keyword mapping, automated SEO insights, and AI content strategy.
